title: Demo report download always 404s: drop_start(analysis_id, 3) maps 'an-aoife' to 'aoife', not 'a-aoife'
evidence:
let application_id = string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)
  let filename = case
    list.find(demo_store.report_filenames(), fn(p) { p.0 == application_id })
  ...
  let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"  -- and the doc comment: "The `analysis_id` (e.g. \"an-aoife\") maps to the application id (\"a-aoife\") which keys the baked PDF." Meanwhile demo_store.gleam seeds analysis ids "an-aoife"/"an-conor"/etc., report_filenames() keys are #("a-aoife", ...), application_detail.gleam:674 dispatches msg.UserClickedDownloadReport(analysis.id), and server/priv/static/demo/ contains only report-a-aoife.pdf-style files (verified via ls).
detail: Violates AC1 'download mock report' clickable in demo state. drop_start("an-aoife",3)="aoife", so the fetch hits /static/demo/report-aoife.pdf (404 -> internal_error toast) and the filename lookup falls back to the generic name. Every demo report download fails; contradicts the PR body's browser-verified claim.
recommended_fix: Prefix after dropping: let application_id = "a-" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3), and add a demo-flow test asserting download resolves Ok for a seeded analysis id.

title: Six of nine demo analytics events are defined but never fired anywhere
evidence:
pub const demo_vacancy_open = "demo_vacancy_open"

pub const demo_application_open = "demo_application_open"

pub const demo_comparison_open = "demo_comparison_open"

pub const demo_archived_open = "demo_archived_open"

pub const demo_report_download = "demo_report_download"

pub const demo_create_vacancy_open = "demo_create_vacancy_open"  -- grep of client/src for these constants and for 'demo_analytics\.' shows only three call sites: client.gleam:5701 (demo_entry), demo_update.gleam:66 (demo_cta_click), demo_update.gleam:72/477 (demo_reset). No source file references the six constants above.
detail: Briefing deliverable 7 requires PostHog events 'capturing entry, key surfaces, downloads, CTA clicks', and the PR body claims 'PostHog demo events (entry, reset, vacancy/app detail, comparison, report download, CTA click)'. Vacancy/application/comparison/archived/report-download/create-vacancy events never fire.
recommended_fix: Fire the defined events at the corresponding demo dispatch points (AppRequestedVacancyDetail, AppRequestedApplicationDetail, AppRequestedComparisonDetails, download success, create-vacancy view) or drop the unused constants and correct the PR body.

title: UserConfirmedApproval refetches the leaderboard from the pre-approval (stale) demo store
detail: demo_status returns the mutated store inside `updated`, but the leaderboard refetch reads store_of(model) — the old store. The real handler (client.gleam:2613-2625) refetches 'so the sweep-nudge banner's should_show_sweep_nudge predicate sees the latest picture (including this applicant's new Approved status)'; in the demo the refetch resolves stale data, defeating that purpose. Diverges from the 'demo dash should match the actual dash' verdict.
recommended_fix: Use store_of(updated) (or the `next` store returned by demo_status) for the leaderboard refetch so it resolves the post-approval state.

title: Demo logout fires the demo_reset event, conflating exit with reset
evidence:
UserClickedLogout -> {
      demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_reset)
      #(
        Model(
          ..model,
          demo_mode: False,
          demo_store: None,
          auth: NotAsked,
          route: routes.Landing,
detail: reset_demo (demo_update.gleam:477) also fires demo_reset, so analytics cannot distinguish 'Reset demo' from exiting the demo back to the landing page. Minor data-quality issue in the consent-gated funnel metrics.
recommended_fix: Add a distinct demo_exit event (or drop the capture on logout) so reset and exit are separable in PostHog.
